units.function: Plugin state-machine facade coordinating persisted status, loader activation/deactivation, worker control, package upgrades, cleanup and process-local lifecycle notifications.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends inward on the plugin registry and outward on the loader, worker manager, database, logger and Node EventEmitter; callers receive a service interface but Paperclip shared records and statuses cross the boundary.
units.keyDataModels: PluginRecord, PluginStatus, manifest capabilities, package version/path, lastError, removeData and lifecycle/worker event payloads.
units.lifecycle: Validates read-time state, persists status, activates or deactivates runtime, upgrades package files, detects added capability strings, optionally waits in upgrade_pending, cleans artifacts, uninstalls and emits in-process events.
units.testAssessment: The only dedicated lifecycle test at this path is a two-case restart regression and both cases pass. It does not exercise the state graph, activation/deactivation failures, concurrent transitions, listener failures, upgrade approval, cleanup retention or durable audit/event delivery.
units.designRationale: Centralize plugin state transitions and ensure hot restart re-reads the manifest and reapplies idempotent migrations rather than merely bouncing a stale worker process.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a governed Connector/plugin installation lifecycle whose declared state cannot diverge from executable reality, and whose upgrade, approval, rollback, retention and actor evidence remain valid across crashes and concurrent operators.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the explicit transition graph, loader/worker separation and full manifest-plus-migration reload. Rebuild lifecycle commands around per-installation serialization or compare-and-swap, staged desired/observed state, compensating recovery, durable outbox events, manifest digests and Responsibility/Approval/DataAuthorization evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: The service carries no company, actor, accountable human, request, approval or evidence context. Database state, filesystem/worker effects and events are not atomic; shutdown failures may be swallowed while disabled/error/uninstalled is persisted, and capability approval is only a flat-string diff without an exact package digest.

units.function: Regression test proving restart uses loader unload/load when runtime services exist and falls back to a bare worker-handle restart otherwise.
units.dependencyDirection: Mocks the registry and supplies loader/worker stubs around the production lifecycle service.
units.keyDataModels: Ready PluginRecord, registered runtime counts and worker lifecycle events.
units.lifecycle: Invokes restart for a ready plugin and asserts either a full deactivate/reactivate cycle or fallback handle restart with stopped/started notifications.
units.testAssessment: Two of two focused Vitest cases passed. The suite captures PAP-9585 call routing but does not prove migrations actually apply or cover reload failure, status reconciliation, idempotency and concurrency.
units.designRationale: Prevent hot-reload schema drift when a local plugin adds a migration.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs compatibility tests proving upgrades and restarts preserve schema/runtime alignment and recover safely from each failure boundary.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the regression intent into contract tests over desired/observed installation state, migration ledger, crash recovery, digest-bound approvals and rollback.
units.responsibilityConflict: No actor, approval, tenant, audit evidence or failure-state assertion is present, so the test cannot establish a trustworthy enterprise lifecycle.
